Ranges, sources, steps, ratios and symbols

Actual exchange execution

Actual exchange execution PF is unavailable in this no-write simulation. Modeled actions are entries, adds and closes; they exclude protection orders.

The simulator submits zero exchange orders. Its closed-price fills do not simulate native minimum quantities, funding, latency or intrabar protection fills. Cash sums and a nominal paper balance across correlated lanes do not constitute an exchange portfolio.

Configuration & calculation coverage

All 19 families calculate across Micro, Minimal, Short, Normal, Long, Wide, Low-Range. TP steps: 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 18, 24, 30; SL / TP: 0.6, 1, 1.4. Fixed, trailing and trailing-only exits; long/short; Normal, Axis, Block and DCA. This bounded replay uses genuine one-minute candles, lookback 20 where configurable, four default Tactic and six default Inverse sources. It does not invent ten-second history from minute OHLC. The larger 2,918-source catalog and supported sub-minute/higher frames have separate functional tests.

Market admission uses available contracts and complete history, never return screening. Current qualified PF divides summed positive net percentage outcomes by the absolute sum of negative outcomes; PF values are never averaged. ∞ means no observed losses in that scope, not a large finite PF.

Method, provenance & all static totals

Observed BingX VST closed one-minute candles only, 72h prehistory and 24h forward unless explicitly overridden. All 19 indication families calculate independently, with balanced TP steps 2/3/5/8/12/18/24/30 and all seven ranges including independent Low-Range, SL/TP 0.6/1/1.4, three exits, long/short and Normal/Axis/Block/DCA. Tactic and Inverse use the ten declared default imported sources; all 2918 selectable source identities are separately covered by functional golden-state tests. Higher timeframes and the full Cartesian catalog are separately tested, not all enabled in this bounded run. The two current 20/8/8 Real-mirror policies compare shared-budget pyramid Block with three-position recovery rounds (three levels, ratio 0.2, one pause round, multiplier cap 3). Both enable per-configuration Auto PF slope 0.2 capped at 2, with the higher of that floor and stage PF 1.1. Each policy warms its own stages from prehistory; unfinished warmup positions are discarded. Every subsequent loss remains in the forward ledger. Symbol admission uses available contracts and complete history only, never returns. This already examined historical interval is a regression comparison, not untouched future validation. No shortlist is chosen from this forward period. The prehistory-selected summaries are a frozen subset of these independent configuration lanes, selected from Base/Normal prehistory outcomes only, with at least 20 closes and PF 1.1 and up to three configurations per range within each indication family. Their forward losses remain included; full-catalog outcomes are shown alongside. They are not a shared-capital exchange portfolio. Enough-samples percentages divide current created sets with their own required completed samples by current created sets; zero sets means unavailable, not 0% passing. Validated-window PF is current selection evidence and is separate from all admitted forward closes. Model fills occur at observed closes and deduct verified taker fees plus fee-relative slippage once; exchange minimum sizing, latency, funding and native protective fills are not simulated. Correlated lane cash totals and 10,000-unit closed-only paper equity do not represent an executable exchange portfolio. Actual exchange PF is unavailable in this no-write simulation. Defaults are not promoted automatically.
